import Figure from "../../../../../src/components/content/Figure.astro";
import Gallery from "../../../../../src/components/content/Gallery.astro";
import QuickSummary from "../../../../../src/components/content/QuickSummary.astro";
import Callout from "../../../../../src/components/content/Callout.astro";
import Blockquote from "../../../../../src/components/content/Blockquote.astro";
import CoverPicture from "../../../../../src/components/Picture.astro";
import sample from "../sample.jpg";

<QuickSummary>

- One concise point.
- Another concise point.

</QuickSummary>

<Figure src={sample} alt="A small test fixture">
  Photo credit from [Example](https://example.com/photo)
</Figure>

<Gallery columns={2}>
  <Figure src={sample} alt="The first fixture" />
  <Figure src={sample} alt="The second fixture" />
</Gallery>

<Gallery columns={3} />

<Gallery columns={4} />

<Callout type="tip">A useful tip.</Callout>

<Callout type="information">Useful information.</Callout>

<Callout type="disclaimer">A useful disclaimer.</Callout>

<CoverPicture
  src={sample}
  alt="A cover fixture"
  caption={'Photo by <a href="https://example.com/cover-credit">Cover Artist</a>'}
/>

<Blockquote author="Ada Example" source="https://example.com/source">
  Useful words.
</Blockquote>
